messages.subject: Invitation: Commercial team CLE - 'Drafting AI and data clauses' (2 Dec)
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi all,

Reminder that the commercial group's CPD session 'Drafting AI and data clauses in technology contracts' is on Tuesday 2 December, 12:30-13:30 in the 6th floor seminar room (lunch provided). It counts for 1 hour of CPD. Please reply if you'd like to attend so we can confirm catering numbers.

Donna
